style: Art-rock post-punk industrial chamber groove with quartal suspended chord fields, chromatic side-steps, angular consonant-heavy scat contour, register jumps, motorik pulse with syncopated sixteenths, sudden metric dropouts, algorithmic polyrhythmic shifts, and microtonal pitch drift. I made a mistake!

[Spoken Deadpan]

I wish I was nowhere instead of this bed.
The local biology treats my epidermis like an open lease,
Demanding micro-tributes just to experience peace.
The pebbles are teeth that chew up my boots,
While venomous whispers crawl down from the shoots.
I cannot negotiate with nitrogen rain,
It washes my sanity straight down the drain.

[Chorus — High Kinetic Density, Trautonium Slide, Massed Consonant Stacks]

Governed by taxonomic goblin classification errors and ontological decompression, the song transforms a stranded plea into an aggressive logistical crisis.
